purpose: Register research Populations as first-class sets (not variables). Complements MeasurementObject Registry. Does not reopen L-003 doctrine.

populations.unit: anatomy trade_dataset opportunity row (one scanner/oracle dual-path opportunity)
populations.membership_rule: Rows in results/research/{instrument}_trade_anatomy/trade_dataset_{INSTRUMENT}.csv for instruments in instrument_scope (L-003F join corpus).
populations.notes: Default domain Omega for Y_scanner / Y_oracle / Y_joint on anatomy join. Dataset SHA256 pins in L-003G JSON.

populations.unit: anatomy opportunity row with joint coordinate STATE_SL_TP
populations.membership_rule: { x in Omega_anatomy_opportunity : Y_joint(x) = STATE_SL_TP } where STATE_SL_TP := (Y_scanner=SL_HIT, Y_oracle=TP_HIT).
populations.notes: Aliases: JOINT_STATE_SL_TP, EARLY_STOP_CANDIDATE (SAFE_ALIAS only). n from L-003F/L-003L mass note. Next episode PATH_GENERATION_FOR_STATE_SL_TP observes path-generation on this population.

anti_slide: Never write Population as a MeasurementObject / variable
Never equate a StateID with a population without set notation
Y_joint : Omega -> S; populations are preimages under Y_joint
